voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Write what you saw under Evidence. Put what you think it means under Hypotheses.
voices.learningIntent: O02 / LO3; separate observation and inference
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Give Evidence and Hypotheses equal weight, with enough space after Evidence for the listener to switch notebook columns.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Copper, fiber and radio can each offer a valid route here. Choose one, then prove that your choice meets its stated conditions.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Make copper, fiber and radio three distinct choices, then let Titan slow slightly on the proof the chosen route needs.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: An ally can help you inspect or change the declared system. A conventional tool can still solve a required repair.
voices.learningIntent: NQ-06; optional collection, valid conventional alternative
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Let the second sentence sound as reassuring as the first, with conventional tool clearly audible.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: You may bring two active allies. Change your team at a safe place; preparation is part of engineering.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Stress two active allies, then give safe place its own beat before the preparation advice.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A physical link can work while an application fails. Name exactly what your test establishes.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Compare Titan's grounded delivery of physical link with application, and listen for the question of exactly what the test establishes.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A hint is another tool. We record its use so the story is honest, not so the ending can scold you.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Let another tool sound welcoming and give ending can scold you a little dry warmth.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Changing the path changes the question. An earlier passing measurement cannot validate the new configuration.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Keep earlier passing measurement together and land the stress on new configuration.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A useful wrong hypothesis is one the evidence has helped you retire. Put the next one on the board.
voices.learningIntent: Nonpunitive feedback; no incorrect solution award
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Check the singular hypothesis and leave a beat after retire so the invitation to try again can land.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A malformed challenge is our authoring problem. It is not a mistake you should be punished for.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Listen for the distinction between authoring problem and mistake, with Titan taking responsibility in the first sentence.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Before committing at the Rift, review your route, its limits and your way back to preparation.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Separate route, limits and way back so the listener can pick out all three checks before committing at the Rift.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: Repeat the link measurements and the declared endpoint test. Arrival at the balcony is not evidence of recovery.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Give link measurements and declared endpoint test two clear stresses, then pause before the balcony observation.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A permanent repair needs a maintenance plan, too. The next apprentice deserves a useful record.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Let maintenance plan carry the first thought and leave room for Titan's concern for the next apprentice.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: A temporary bridge can be a sound decision. Say what it depends on, and say when the lasting repair is due.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Keep temporary bridge approving in tone and separate the dependency from the due date for the lasting repair.

voices.speaker: Titan
voices.caption: You chose to isolate an unresolved fault safely. Continue when you are ready to return to preparation.
voices.learningIntent: E03; safe continuation, no false restoration
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Leave unresolved fault intact, pause after safely and read Continue as an invitation.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: I am Photon. I carry light and an unreasonable amount of optimism. Shall we inspect that dark link lamp?
voices.scope: Actual existing game use documented
voices.listenFor: Check Photon's name on the opening beat, leave the joke about optimism room to land, and listen for dark link lamp in the question.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: The power lamp is cheerful. The link lamp has declined to comment. We should record both.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Give the power lamp and link lamp their own beats before the short instruction to record both.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Your notebook keeps clues you have found. You do not have to remember every word I say.
voices.learningIntent: NQ-04; persistence within adventure, not account-save promise
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Let found finish the first thought and ease Photon's pace through every word I say.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Compare the recovered bits with the known lab pattern. That comparison is not a universal error detector built into every physical link.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Keep recovered bits and known lab pattern distinct, then give universal error detector and every physical link enough space to hear the limitation.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Start with the connector inspection. A dramatic theory can wait while we look for an ordinary defect.
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Make connector inspection plain before letting Photon's wry dramatic theory give way to ordinary defect.

voices.speaker: Photon
voices.caption: Use the inspection equipment. Never look directly into a live optical port or fiber end.
voices.learningIntent: Safe optical inspection language; technical reviewer confirms production wording
voices.scope: Planned dialogue placement; review page is an isolated fixture
voices.listenFor: Give Never its full stress and make both live optical port and fiber end clear in the safety instruction.
